etymology.historical_story: One documented cultural bearer of this name is Marcie in Peanuts, whose named debut was on July 20, 1971. The Schulz Museum explains that the cartoonist named her after a friend of his two youngest daughters. This establishes the character’s naming story, rather than the ultimate etymology of the personal name or the identity intended by this input. Sources: [Peanuts](https://www.peanuts.com/about/marcie), [Schulz Museum](https://schulzmuseum.org/celebrating-peanuts-online/).
